name: Terraces
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original wide 16:9 raster background for a minimalist personal website, 2048x1152 composition.
Primary request: gently curving terraced hills seen from an oblique elevated angle, shallow ribbon-like bands, minimal and dreamlike, without clouds.
Scene: a sparse landscape of long softly scalloped terraced contours, like sculpted stepped earth gradually disappearing into luminous atmospheric haze.
Style/medium: delicate retro-computational landscape art with fine ASCII-like character halftone integrated into the terrain contours; tiny abstract nonverbal typographic marks and restrained stippling create tonal shading, like muted vintage terminal art printed on matte paper.
Composition: the terraces live mostly in the lower third and along bottom corners; upper and central 60% is quiet nearly flat pale sage with an extremely subtle fade into mist. Low horizon, broad spacious composition, no large objects in the central text-safe region. Do not fill the entire image with texture; the upper expanse is nearly clean.
Lighting/mood: buttercream ambient light on shallow upper ledges and gentle dusty teal shadow below, contemplative, softly luminous, low contrast.
Color palette: muted pale sage and celadon ground, pale buttercream highlights, dusty desaturated teal shadows; avoid black and bright white.
Constraints: original natural landform, calm high-quality background asset. No clouds, no text, no readable letters or numerals, no labels, no axes, no UI, no logos, no frame, no buildings, no people, no trees, no sunset disk. Fine ASCII-inspired halftone is abstract texture only, never writing.
